title: The Slate Accepted
note: Wren's interior of Mnehmos's descent + address. Her name lands fifth (last) in the canonical order — 'the last position, which is where a quartermaster belongs.' Mnehmos addresses the attendants BY HER NAME with the slate instruction; she now knows the slate was always for her. She lifts it without ceremony. First marks: the five names of the cohort. ⟦ RECORD-SLATE BOUND TO WREN ADEBAYO · FIRST MARKS WRITTEN ⟧

events.observed: Mnehmos descends 7 shallow steps; chamber's attention rotates with him; instrument-bearer moves toward 2 tremor-handed summoners

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: Cole Maddox. Renata Salk. Bohdan Cerny. Yuki Aritomo. Wren Adebayo.
events.wren_reaction: Name lands fifth and last — 'a stake driven into the ground, but driven for me. Not the first or the privileged position. The last position, which is where a quartermaster belongs.'

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: I am Mnehmos. I performed the rite that brought you here.

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: You are in Sebastopyr. This chamber is in the Cathedral Sebastinum, above the Vas Halidani that holds the Grace I spent to bring you. The city beyond it is real. So are its risks.
events.wren_reaction: Geography clicks into language. Exits she catalogued in ch01 (east door, dais drapery, NW passage) remain unchanged.

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: The understanding that lets our speech meet is provisional. It will hold until the third day at evening.
events.wren_reaction: Marks the hour. 'A deadline is not comfort; it is information.'

events.returned: LANGUAGE BRIDGE: PROVISIONAL · expires PD 606 · DAY 3 · 18:00

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: Place a record-slate where Adebayo can see it; she will want to track the headcount before she trusts a single one of us.
events.wren_reaction: Mnehmos has named her BY her surname to instruct attendants. Slate was placed for her on purpose; he has read her reflex. The act of saying it aloud is itself an offer.

events.note: Not a grab. 'The decisive kind of lift you perform when you know you are not stealing a thing but taking your own instrument of knowledge.' Slate is cold stone, ordinary — no glow, no light, no magic. Heavier than paper, lighter than the roster it replaces.

events.action: writes 5 names with chalk-stub on slate
events.note: Five lines, in the order she heard them. Each name its own line. Each line its own boundary.

events.returned: RECORD-SLATE BOUND TO WREN ADEBAYO · FIRST MARKS WRITTEN
events.note: Bound by use, not by magic. The slate is ordinary stone.

ledger_state_at_chapter_end.slate_status: BOUND to Wren Adebayo · first marks: 5 cohort names in canonical order
ledger_state_at_chapter_end.geography_committed: Sebastopyr / Cathedral Sebastinum / Vas Halidani (cistern, not river) / Vocation House Inner Chamber

agent_calls.editorial_note: Agent draft introduced several canon contradictions that required substantial editorial repair: (1) called Vas Halidani a 'river' — corrected: cistern (per all other biographies and Mnehmos's own ch02). (2) Invented 'two main doors to the north and south; a narrow service passage along the west wall' — corrected: kept Wren's own ch01 catalogue (east door, dais drapery, NW passage). (3) Had Mnehmos's slate-placement instruction as 'words not spoken aloud, yet they travel across the chamber' — corrected: per Mnehmos's ch02 ledger, that line IS spoken aloud as an attendant directive. (4) Had the slate 'glow with a pale, ritual light' and 'written with light rather than ink' — corrected: slate is ordinary cold stone; bound by USE, not magic. (5) Had cohort 'positions' that contradicted other interiors (e.g. Bohdan 'near the tremor-handed instrument' — he is on one knee at the slab he was reading). (6) Trailed off into meta-commentary ('END OF CH.2 — THE SLATE ACCEPTED' as a literal in-doc marker). The clean version preserves Wren's best lines verbatim: 'I am here to measure, not to narrate. I learn the room by counting, then counting again.' / 'I lift. Not a quick grab, but the decisive kind of lift you perform when you know you are not stealing a thing but taking your own instrument of knowledge.' / 'The last position, which is where a quartermaster belongs.' Wren's tendency to drift into meta and fabrication on long-horizon outputs is now a known agent failure mode, logged for future invocations.
